channel.title: Fire Engineering Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Fire Engineering Magazine (fireengineering.com)

item.title: Cal Fire Task Force Recommends Tougher Fireworks Oversight After Explosion
item.description: A California task force issued 35 recommendations to fireworks laws and oversight after a deadly explosion, highlighting licensing gaps and the need for stricter regulations and enforcement.

item.title: Lawsuit: Gas Explosion Hit MS Apartments Hours After Inspection
item.description: Three South Mississippi residents have filed a lawsuit against the city and contractors, claiming injuries from a gas explosion due to inadequate inspections and permit violations prior to service restoration.

item.title: Dallas Logs 280 Vehicle Accidents During TX Winter Storm
item.description: During a winter storm in Dallas, authorities responded to around 280 vehicle accidents as over 250 drivers ventured onto icy roads. Despite the conditions, accident numbers were lower than expected.

item.title: Person Dies in Fire on Fifth Floor of Jersey City (NJ) Building
item.description: A fire in Jersey City on Tuesday night resulted in one death and displaced seven residents.

item.title: Overloaded Surge Protector Sparks Fire that Destroys HI Dental Office
item.description: A fire at the Kahala Professional Building was caused by an overloaded surge protector, classified as accidental, resulting in $664,000 in damages but no injuries reported.

item.title: One Dead, One Injured in MD House Fire
item.description: A house fire in West Baltimore resulted in one death and one injury.

item.title: Icy Track Derails Amtrak Train With Over 100 Passengers in MA
item.description: An Amtrak train with over 100 passengers derailed in Northfield but no injuries were reported. Passengers were safely transferred to buses after the incident.

item.title: OH House Fire Leaves One Dead, One in Hospital
item.description: One person died and another was hospitalized after a house fire in Painesville.

item.title: Three RI Firefighters Injured in Flashover at House Fire
item.description: Three firefighters were hospitalized after a flashover while battling a house fire in Cranston. The fire caused a partial roof collapse, leading to significant ice hazards at the scene.

item.title: Big Training, Small Budget: Get Resourceful in Your Community
item.description: Host Frank Ricci welcomes David Polikoff, Robert “RJ” James, and Dave McGlynn to discuss creating effective training props without breaking the budget.
